title: BlockRegistry
description: Per-block property definitions. Keys are BlockType enum names.

solid.description: Whether the block blocks movement and is used in AO calculation.

transparent.description: Whether the block allows light through (leaves, glass).

minimapColor.description: RGB color shown on the minimap [R, G, B] (0-255).

modelElement.description: bbmodel element name to use for rendering. Defaults to the block's own name when empty.

liquid.description: Whether the block is a liquid (propagates, slows players).

viscosity.description: Liquid viscosity: ticks delay between propagation steps and player speed factor. 0 = not a liquid.

replaceable.description: Whether a player can place a block here (overwriting this block). True for AIR, WATER, FLOWER, WEED.

vegetationHost.description: Whether flowers and weeds can grow on top of this block. True for GRASS.

treeAllowed.description: Whether trees can grow on top of this block. False for SAND, SANDSTONE.
